answer.says: You are correct. The universal law of exchange has done its work; now the particularity of the body must assert itself. I shall finish it with the dignity of a man who has no other choice but to obey his stomach.
answer.thought: The market does not care for my metaphysics, only for the oil on the counter. I will consume the samosa, for the body is the first sphere of want that must be satisfied before the spirit can claim freedom.
